LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive Gantt chart powered by D3.js. Renders date-range tasks as horizontal bars on a time axis.

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.description: SOQL query to fetch tasks (used when no Drill-Down Object is set)
property.placeholder: SELECT Name, Project_Start__c, Project_End__c FROM Opportunity

property.name: labelField
property.label: Label Field
property.description: API name of the task label field

property.name: startDateField
property.label: Start Date Field
property.description: API name of the task start date field

property.name: endDateField
property.label: End Date Field
property.description: API name of the task end date field

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Drill-Down Object
property.description: Object API name for server-side fetch and navigation on task click

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Label Field)

property.name: filterClause
property.label: Filter Clause
property.description: Optional WHERE clause fragment for the server-side fetch

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum tasks to process. Leave empty for default.
